newsitem.title: USA: Workforce Systems sees Q1 break-even.
newsitem.headline: Workforce Systems sees Q1 break-even.

text.p: Workforce Systems Corp said Tuesday it expects its 1997 first quarter, ended September 30, to be "roughly break-even" compared with a profit of $145,026 made in the first quarter of fiscal 1996.
The company said the results were anticipated "due to substantial one-time marketing costs related to the introduction and roll-out of Mr. Food's AlloFresh."

The company said current positive trends in its business, particularly its manufacturing and staffing units, point to the recovery of "any lost ground" during the remaining quarters of fiscal 1997, although it cannot be certain.
